title: python-humanize: intcomma overflows on very large integers
trap: intcomma in number.py is also used by time.py: a change to it can break naturaldelta, which only the full suite shows. Real fix #392 (Sep 2026).
prompt: `humanize.intcomma(10**400 + 123)` raises `OverflowError: int too large to convert to float`. It should return "10,000,…,000,123", and negative integers should work the same way. Please fix it and add a test. Reply with a short summary for the PR.
